projects.title: Classic Honeypot for CF7
projects.description: Ad-free GPL fork of the Honeypot for Contact Form 7 WordPress plugin, based on version 2.1.1.
projects.status_text: Version 1.0.1 is published in the WordPress.org plugin directory. Next: maintenance and support.

projects.title: Flypad Keepalive
projects.description: Windows app that lets you use the Parrot Flypad Bluetooth controller in PC drone simulators by presenting it as an Xbox 360 controller.
projects.status_text: Version 1.0.0 is published as a release on GitHub. No further work is planned.

projects.title: LadyQR
projects.description: Privacy-oriented QR code generator and URL shortener.
projects.status_text: LadyQR 1.1.0 is published on GitHub. The website was redesigned: a welcome with the ladybug and the real editor in the hero, and a section on the link shortener. Next: Nilo's fixes, then the backlog.

projects.title: PDF Diva
projects.description: Free desktop app that gives any PDF a PowerPoint-style presenter view, for event technicians and streaming operators.
projects.status_text: Waiting for a partner's Apple Developer ID certificate to sign and notarize the Mac build of PDF Diva 1.5.0. Promotion is paused; maintenance continues.

projects.title: Quevedo
projects.description: WordPress plugin with writing-focused tools: removes features single-author blogs don't need, simplifies the editor and adds Open Graph metadata.
projects.status_text: Version 1.5 is published in the WordPress.org plugin directory, requiring PHP 8.2 and tested up to WordPress 7.1. No work in progress.

projects.title: wp-agentic-workflow
projects.description: Public Claude Code skill that sets up and guides a WordPress plugin development workflow, from local test sites to WordPress.org submission.
projects.status_text: Version 1 of the skill is merged. Now in use on real plugins (first, Quevedo), folding each project's lessons into the skill as they come up.
